chapter_title_en: The Lord of the Dead City
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch 332: Lord of the Dead City – Ancient Soldiers Awaken
chapter_meta_description: The Dead City descends upon the world. Xiao Chen and Qingqing stand on its walls as ancient soldiers slaughter the Sun Knight Order. A mysterious mark appears on Xiao Chen's forehead.
og_title: The Dead City's Lord: Xiao Chen's Unwilling Ascension
og_description: Xiao Chen is thrust into the role of Dead City's master as ancient soldiers rise and a figure in the burial shroud appears.
twitter_description: Ancient soldiers emerge as the Dead City descends. Xiao Chen gains a mysterious mark and is hailed as its master.
